When the deposit lands, record it once.
On the project's payment schedule, find the phase, enter the amount, the date, how it came in and the check number, and mark it Received.
That is the only place you type it. Everything else recalculates.
The project balance drops. The dashboard's Received Amount goes up and Outstanding goes down by the same figure.
And over in Accounts Receivable the row leaves the aging list, because it is no longer money you are chasing.
Nothing is entered twice and nothing needs reconciling at the end of the month.
